# Security policy

Follow the [upstream Syntra security policy](https://github.com/tinkle-org/syntra/blob/main/SECURITY.md),
including its supported-version guidance and private reporting process.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting for Syntra](https://github.com/tinkle-org/syntra/security/advisories/new)
instead of a public issue. Identify `tinkle-org/syntra-rs`, the affected
crate and commit, and include a minimal reproduction without credentials
or private data.
